name: Everything in Evanston A 2023
information:
All speedsolving events will be held at this competition! Because this is not a typical competition, all competitors must read the [Competition Format](#26676-competition-format) tab. Competitors not interested in blindfolded events should consider registering for the other competition in this series: [Everything in Evanston B](EverythinginEvanstonB2023).

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
